item: routes without a UI caller: generator + ratchet (Lane M)
summary: Source-only sweep of 820 routes against every URL literal in src/static and src/tui; 235 have no UI caller, each hand-checked and classed internal, superseded or feature (76 reader features with no button, ranked and routed to their lanes). The test fails on a new uncalled route or a stale row and holds the feature count to a zero-slack ceiling.
